declared_before: any arm code was written, any arm was extracted, and any arm was scored; stage-0 anatomy and the zero-GPU tracker replay were complete and are the evidence this registration is built on
split: DEV-20 only; TEST-38 / test-49 / challenge not read, extracted or scored

brief_premise.as_given: the detection-miss bucket needs a detector retrain; oracle +6.99 GS-DetA, realistic +2..4.4
brief_premise.verdict: REFUTED by stage 0 -- see stage0_findings; no detector training is registered

stage0_findings.reading: 71.4% of the miss bucket (16,378 of 23,677) is chain loss on rows the detector already produced at >= 0.20. A perfect detector adds at most 2.89 recall points; the chain after the detector loses 7.2.

control.name: A0
control.what: the shipped chain re-extracted TODAY on a100server1 GPU 1, same env, same weights (gsr_v3_ft_b/weights/last.pt, md5 2074d8741f97a6892a1322d0f808244c), variant _w7ctl
control.why: kb v8-w4-004 -- an arm produced on this stack may only be paired against a control produced on this stack
control.secondary_read: its positions parquets are also diffed against the on-record 2026-08-07 server artifacts, which measures within-machine stack drift directly

arms.name: A1 keepall
arms.change: generator.tracking.KEEP_UNTRACKED = True -- ByteTrackBackend additionally writes through every input detection the tracker did not return, with a fresh track id
arms.mechanism: supervision.ByteTrack.update_with_detections returns only input rows whose box matches a returned Kalman track box at IoU >= 0.5, so it silently discards 8.0% of the detector's confident boxes (250,705 -> 230,753 on DEV-20). tools.gsr_eiou.associate re-derives every tracklet from raw boxes and never drops a row, so the tracker's filtering buys the chain nothing.

arms.name: A2 m1
arms.why: the cheap ablation of A1: how much of the recovered mass is only track-confirmation latency
arms.order: run only after A1 completes, budget permitting

arms_considered_and_refused.detector_retrain_more_epochs: ceiling +2.89 recall points; the whole detector-level bucket is 1,978 rows (0.84% of GT). 4-6 GPU-h for less mass than A1's 11,900 rows at zero training.
arms_considered_and_refused.imgsz_1280: S4/S4b measured -30.8 big-box recall at 1280; not repeated.
arms_considered_and_refused.occlusion_augmentation: crowding (GT-GT IoU >= 0.3) carries 12.3% of detector-level misses = 2,414 rows.
arms_considered_and_refused.lower_DETECT_CONF: the replay prices conf 0.20 -> 0.10 at +0.15 recall points once min_hits is fixed, and kb v8-w4 warns downstream thresholds are calibrated to the shipped confidence distribution. Not worth an arm.

gates.primary: paired DEV-20 vs the A0 control: GS-DetA >= +1.00 AND GS-HOTA not worse, measured on the FULL post-processing stack (vote_track_attributes(role,team,jersey) + gk_side_repair(('team',)) ON for both sides)
gates.secondary: per-sequence paired GS-HOTA helped > hurt with Wilcoxon p < 0.05, n = 20
gates.reported_regardless: the same numbers with both flags OFF; image-space GT recall of the arm's positions; prediction row count; track count; GS-AssA and GS-LocA
gates.noise: no training is involved, so there is no seed variance to measure; extraction is bit-deterministic run to run on one stack (kb v8-w4-004). The known cross-stack hazard is -1.14 paired GS-HOTA and is avoided by construction: control and arms are extracted on the same machine, same env, within the same session.

environment.gpu_host: a100server1 (192.168.3.19), GPU 1 only, tmux, versioned output dirs
